entities.text: Niloy Sarkar vs Atanu Das & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
. 
Mr. Sekhar Kumar Basu, Sr. Advocate ...for the opposite party nos. 1 to 4 Mr. S.G. Mukherjee, Mr.
Imran Ali, Ms. Debjani Sahu ...for the State Heard Ms. Sahu, learned counsel representing the State and Mr. Basu, learned Senior Advocate representing the opposite party nos. 1 to 4.
It is submitted that an order of acquittal was recorded by the learned Trial Court in a case under Sections 498A/306/34 of the IPC.
The State has preferred an appeal challenging such order.
Prescribed punishment for an offence committed under Section 306 of the IPC of either description for a term which may extend to 10 years and shall also be liable to fine.
Since the matter has been assigned by the Hon'ble The Chief Justice, liberty is given to Mr. Basu to take appropriate steps.
The matter is adjourned to appear on 10th May, 2023 with liberty to mention.

(Siddhartha Roy Chowdhury, J.)
